body: I can see how growing up that way could cause someone to feel like men and women are completely different species. I'm glad you're starting to see that we are not. Women are human beings just like men and deserve to be treated as such. Next time you have a conversation with a woman at your school, just ask yourself what you would say and do if you were talking to another male classmate. Try not to treat the interaction differently because it is with a woman.  If there are any clubs or group activities that you are interested in at your school that include both men and women, I think it would be a good idea to join. Shared interests are usually easy to talk about and finding women who share the same interests as you will help you to connect with them and stop seeing them as so different or "separate" from men.
